name: Arc Lightning
description: The creature chooses one creature or object within 120 feet and up to three other creatures or objects within 30 feet of the first target. Each target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
